essence: Arjuna's inquiry sets up the teaching on field, knower, knowledge, and knowable.
The body is the field, and the one who knows it is the field-knower.
The one Self is knower in every field; true knowing discerns field from knower.
A concise account of the field and its knower is requested.
The author offers a concise unified explanation despite prior varied teachings.
